root_idea.summary: The root centers on something continuing, passing onward, or progressing through time.
root_idea.development: This orientation appears in the temporal noun سَاعَة, in hourly hiring, and in uses for leaving camels to proceed on their own; the latter develops into meanings of neglect, loss, and related derived descriptions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun سَاعَة.
Displayed as the distinct proper name سُوَاع.
The temporal-tagged occurrence is the same lexical item سَاعَة and is subsumed under its ordinary temporal sense.

senses.definition: A portion or period of time: an hour, a short while, or another brief interval.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for ordinary temporal duration, including expressions meaning for or during an hour or a little while; this is distinct from the eschatological use of السَّاعَة.

senses.definition: The Hour: the Resurrection and the raising of humanity for reckoning, or the time of its occurrence.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used in the definite form السَّاعَةُ; the Quranic usage may refer to the resurrection itself or to the time when it will occur.

senses.definition: An individual’s death, understood as that person’s appointed “hour” at the end of worldly life.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative “small Hour” reading, explicitly applied to the sudden coming of the hour in the Quranic discussion of those who deny meeting God.

senses.definition: Suwaʿ, the name of an idol worshipped by the people of Noah.
senses.usage_conditions: A proper name occurring in the Quranic enumeration of idols.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be left to oneself or without a herder, and so to proceed without supervision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested particularly of camels in the cited lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hourly hiring or bargaining: to engage someone for work by the hour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional form modeled on hiring by the day or by another fixed period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave someone or something unattended or neglected, with the result that it is lost or destroyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical use includes abandoning livestock and neglecting a dependent creature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass from hour to hour, or to remain behind, be held back, or be delayed for a period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time-related use distinct from the Form IV meaning of neglecting or losing something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period or portion of the night, especially a quiet interval after the night has become still; also an hour or short period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for coming after a period of the night has elapsed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A formally measured division of day or night, including the astronomical hour; by extension, the present time or the moment at hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical Arabic temporal and deictic uses beyond the Quranic senses listed under the public Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The death of a generation or the passing away of the people of an age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative designation distinguishing the death of a generation from the universal Resurrection and from an individual’s death.
A figurative extension of the temporal noun attested in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe, grievous, or distressing hour or period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional descriptive expression for an especially difficult time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Left to oneself, neglected, or abandoned; in a plural usage, perishing, being destroyed, or dying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The first use describes neglect, while the plural-like use describes a resulting state of perdition or destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A habitual abandoner: a she-camel that leaves its young or wanders away in pasture; also a person who neglects or loses livestock or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical descriptions include both the animal use and the corresponding description of a person who neglects valuables or livestock.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unattended-camel use is represented under سَاعَ.
Neglect resulting in loss or destruction is represented.
Passing or delaying from hour to hour is represented.
A period or quiet interval of the night is represented.
The unit's ordinary temporal branch is covered by the Quranic duration sense; its measured and deictic uses are separately represented classically.
The Resurrection or its time is Quran-attested.
The death of a generation is represented as a Classical figurative use.
The severe or distressing time expression is represented.
The idol proper name is represented under سُوَاع.
Neglect and the resulting state of perdition are represented under سَائِع.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the following paragraph.
The animal and human uses of مِسْيَاع are represented.

cautions: The Resurrection, an individual's death, and the ordinary temporal duration are distinct uses of سَاعَة; the individual-death reading is a figurative “small Hour” interpretation of the cited Quranic passage.
The temporal-tagged Quran occurrence is merged with the nominal form because it is the same lexical headword, while broader Classical figurative extensions remain separate.
